root.text: Miller: I had nothing to do with Elena's death. Yes, she was a headache, but she made our ratings skyrocket! We were planning a mock assassination attempt to drive up publicity. That's why the cameras cut.

choices.text: Confront about keycard access swiped at 10:02 PM

confront_keycard.text: Miller: (Sweating) Okay, fine! I did swipe into the corridor at 10:02 PM. But only to verify if the cables were cut! Elena was already dead by then. I ran away because I didn't want to get blamed!

insurance_motive.text: Miller: Of course the network had insurance. But a murder trial is a PR disaster, not a payout. Julian was the one who stood to gain her executive producer chair.

root.text: Henderson: Look, I was fired yesterday because Elena found out I was taking kickbacks. I was mad, yes. I threatened her. But I wasn't even in the building. I was drinking at the Coffee Shop.

alibi_check.text: Henderson: The bartender remembers me. Ask them. I'm a loud drinker. I wouldn't waste my time cutting camera lenses anyway.

root.text: Senator Sterling: I am a public servant. Elena Voss ran a defamatory segment about me, but I handle my disputes in court, not in dark studios. I was at home in Elmwood all night.

choices.text: Confront with garage receipt stub (stamped 9:55 PM)

confront_garage.text: Senator Sterling: (Frowning) ...My driver must have used that garage. I was not in the vehicle. This is an intrusion on my privacy.

root.text: Julian Cole: Elena and I were partners. Yes, we had creative differences, but she was a brilliant journalist. I was in my dressing room preparing my notes during the broadcast. I never saw her tonight.

choices.text: Confront about fingerprint on Elena's coffee mug

confront_fingerprint.text: Julian Cole: (Sighs) I brought her coffee at 9:50 PM. We had a brief discussion about the show timeline. She was nervous. But she was perfectly fine when I left her.

root.text: Vance: I run security. The broadcast cameras cut because of a main transformer power grid failure at 10:00 PM. No backup generators kicked in due to a relay fuse pop.

choices.text: Confront with server power logs (no power grid failure)
Confront with restored audio tape threat

confront_power.text: Vance: (Stares coldly) Server logs can be corrupted. Main grids are tricky. I stand by my report.

confront_audio.text: Vance: ...That tape is a fabrication. Voss was digging into matters that didn't concern her. You are playing a dangerous game, detective. Walk away.
